shouldFix.title: The extraction omits file 04's own DR-113 standing sentence and the CD-RT-5 posture it asserts is preserved, without disclosing that it is partial
shouldFix.what: The artifact carries file 04 lines 123-139 and 236-242 and nothing else. I read the whole file - 252 lines, thirteen headed sections - and searched every line outside those ranges for replay, purge, GC, removal, degradation, tombstone and inspection. Material bearing directly on DR-113 sits in at least three unextracted regions.

whatIsMissing.theRowsOwnStandingSentence: File 04 lines 33-36 read: 'Replay, verification, inspection, purge, degradation, and their typed result/exit remain open pending the accepted evidence/retention + D9 successor - the integration half. DR-008 (PARTIALLY SATISFIED) and DR-113 own that closure.' That is the only sentence in file 04 that names DR-113, it states the row's standing and its ownership of the closure, and it is the load-bearing warrant for the artifact's own reservation of typed results and exits. It is not carried.
whatIsMissing.theCdRt5PostureItself: extractedRules.purgedPosture asserts 'CD-RT-5 PURGED product posture is preserved'. The posture is defined at file 04 lines 11-28: bounds independent across time, size and count; a bound firing enters PURGED as degradation, not silent deletion; the record stays addressable, retains recordCasRef and keeps a tombstone; entry requires a reason from a named set; default DURABLE_RETAINED. None of that is carried, so in an artifact whose stated discipline is 'Exact file lines' the one product posture it claims to preserve is asserted rather than carried. The same passage also records that the product decision 'does not ... add a D9 code' and does not close retention-loss residual RT23-B-RES-01 - directly on point for the artifact's D9 reservation, and also uncarried.
whatIsMissing.theGcProhibition: File 04 line 73-74 states 'remove and GC cannot delete bytes/state referenced by locks, active processes, retained evidence, rollback slots, or prepared migrations.' extractedRules.gcReachabilityFrom carries the positive reachability roots from the extracted section but not this prohibition, which is the enforceable half of the same rule.

shouldFix.whyItMatters: authorityClaim calls this 'the DR-113 leftover T2-02 extraction' - definite article - and registerRowQuoted reproduces a row whose source cell is the whole of file 04. A coordinator reading the artifact has no way to tell that file 04 says more about DR-113 than is carried here, because nothing in the artifact says the extraction is partial or names what was left out. Omitting the one sentence that names DR-113 and assigns it the closure is the sharpest instance: it is the sentence a reviewer would most expect a DR-113 extraction to contain.
shouldFix.inFairness: purpose does scope the work to 'file 04's replay/removal and purge sections', and both of those sections are carried byte-exactly. Nothing asserted is false, the row stays OPEN, and no typed outcome is invented. The defect is that the scoping is never disclosed as excluding DR-113-relevant material, and that the CD-RT-5 claim reaches outside the carried scope while the supporting text does not come with it.
shouldFix.whyNotABlocker: No contract claim is false and nothing is fail-open. The omitted text is one hop away in a file the artifact pins by digest, and that digest reproduces, so the material is fully recoverable.
shouldFix.minimumRepair: Carry file 04 lines 33-36 as a third verbatim block - it is the row's standing statement - and either carry lines 11-28 behind the CD-RT-5 claim or reword that claim to cite rather than assert. Add one sentence stating that the extraction covers named sections only and naming the file-04 regions deliberately excluded.

shouldFix.title: The acceptance-evidence cell is quoted but not decomposed, and two of its three elements get no standing
shouldFix.location: /registerRowQuoted, measured against live file 08 line 295 cell 5
shouldFix.what: The live DR-113 acceptance-evidence cell reads 'DR-002-008 successors; exact typed results/exits; pin/GC/removal tests' - three named elements. The artifact quotes the row containing it but records no acceptanceEvidenceCellVerbatim and no obligation decomposition, so no element is mapped to where it is answered or reserved. Measuring coverage myself: 'exact typed results/exits' is thoroughly and explicitly reserved; 'DR-002-008 successors' is only partly touched, since identityDependencies names DR-007 and DR-008 but the string DR-002 appears in the artifact solely inside the quoted row; and 'pin/GC/removal tests' has its rules extracted but the word test appears exactly once in the artifact, inside that same quoted row - no test class is named, reserved, or routed to a later gate.
shouldFix.whyItMatters: A T2-02 candidate exists to be reviewable against its row's acceptance evidence. Without a map, a reader cannot distinguish an element that is deliberately reserved from one that was not considered, and two of the three fall in that ambiguous space. The project's own stated value - naming things so that silence exists nowhere - is what this omission cuts against, and the sibling DR-118 candidate demonstrates the remedy: it decomposes its cell fragment by fragment and marks the undecided one RESERVED with an explicit evidence remainder.
shouldFix.inFairness: The artifact never claims to answer the cell, and its purpose is honestly narrower than the row. No coverage is overstated; the defect is silence, not misrepresentation. Two of the three elements are also substantively touched - the typed-result reservation is exemplary, and pin, GC and removal rules are all extracted even though the test class is not.
shouldFix.whyNotABlocker: Nothing false is asserted, no row is marked SATISFIED, and the missing map is additive work rather than a correction to anything already recorded.
shouldFix.minimumRepair: Record acceptanceEvidenceCellVerbatim and decompose it into its three elements, giving each a standing - answered here, RESERVED, or discharging at a named later gate. In particular state where pin/GC/removal tests are authored and which DR-002-008 successors this row waits on.
